messages:
incident-bot: Scheduled maintenance window: EU serving pool will be placed into read-only mode for KV compaction on 2024-07-22 02:00-02:30 UTC. This will cause brief API 429s for write-heavy requests. Posting pre-notice to status page tomorrow at 08:00 UTC. @emma.sre @michael.oncall please ack.

emma.sre: ack. can we scope to just the eu-serving partition (no control plane change)?
michael.oncall: ack. yes — routing only, control plane unchanged. plan: sequential node drain, 2x parallel compactions, health checks between steps. I’ll own the on-call handoff for the window.
julie.support: fyi will draft customer email. recommend wording that highlights read-only impact and rollback plan.
nate.prod: can we shorten to 20m if compaction goes quick? saves a lot of customer risk.
emma.sre: we can try. keep target 30m with a possible early-complete message. fallback is rollback to pre-compaction routing if errors >5% in 5m.
ops-rotations: noted for ops calendar. please add the runbook link.
michael.oncall: runbook pinned: ```https://internal.redwood/runbooks/eu-kv-compaction``` — steps: preflight, drain, compaction, verify, restore writes. Rolling back means re-enable writes and drain-lift in reverse order.
julie.support: drafting customer notice (short):
```
Hello,

We will perform a short maintenance on our EU serving pool on July 22, 02:00-02:30 UTC. During this time write requests may receive 429s; reads are unaffected. We expect no data loss and will notify when complete. If you rely on high write throughput, consider pausing heavy ingest for the 30-minute window.

Status page: https://status.redwood.ai

Regards,
Redwood Ops
```
nate.prod: status page copy suggestion: "Short maintenance: EU serving read-only for KV compaction (02:00–02:30 UTC). Potential brief write throttling. We will post an update when writes resume."
emma.sre: agree. add a line about rollback threshold and contact: `#support` + pager.
michael.oncall: I'll post the status page pre-notice tomorrow and coordinate the handoff with whoever is on call after 02:30. Oncall handoff note: if compaction exceeds 35m or error rate spikes, escalate to SRE lead and pause further compactions.
julie.support: queued customer emails template ready — will send 1h prior and 10m prior.
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: pre-notice will post at 2024-07-21 08:00 UTC.
michael.oncall: after window — quick post: wrote status update and sent completion note.
[2024-07-22 02:22 UTC] michael.oncall: Completed compaction early. verified write path healthy, no elevated error rates. Re-enabled writes at 02:20 UTC. Posting final status update now.
julie.support: sent completion emails to impacted tenants at 02:25 UTC.
emma.sre: good job. will file short postmortem if any anomalies show up; otherwise mark as maintenance complete. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Status page update: "Completed — writes restored at 02:20 UTC. No customer-visible degraded performance after restoration."
